    • buildInternal

      protected WindowTimeRTIndicator buildInternal()
      Builds a WindowTimeRTIndicator with the configured duration, indicator, listener, and state store. The listener receives notifications when the time window elapses, and the supplier routes the window's state (timestamps and whatever the listener writes) at the store it returns. Only the supplier is captured here — it is called at event time, so the store behind it may still be swapped after the window is built.
      Specified by:
      buildInternal in class InstrumentMapRTIndicatorBuilder<WindowTimeRTIndicator>
      Returns:
      the configured WindowTimeRTIndicator
